title: Aurora outlasts TLPH in 7-game thriller to reach MPL PH grand finals, books M8 spot
summary: Aurora Gaming PH (RORA) clinched the second grand finals spot in the MPL Philippines Season 18 after outlasting Team Liquid Philippines (TLPH) in a seven-game thriller, 4-3, on Saturday.
